segments.title: Hype Train Cold Open & Freestyle Derailment
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Hype Train commandeers feed for high-tempo freestyle rap about mortality, chain-buying, and 'jizz' jazz genre before collapsing back to hell.

segments.title: Diddy Raids: Sex Trafficking Investigation Breaks
segments.notes: Case covers Homeland Security raids on Combs' LA and Miami homes, Cassie Ventura settlement, and multiple civil suits; Case admits former fandom revoked.

segments.title: Bridges vs Boats (Both Transformers)
segments.notes: Munch argues bridge transformer is superior hard counter to boats; Crum champions boat mobility and uncle-hosted get-togethers. Munch wins 50/50 chat vote, extends lead to four debates.

segments.title: Science Eyes Studio Build & Blood Facial Tease
segments.notes: Case announces Chet Guy studio nearly complete; Beyblade chat activity signals tomorrow's Science Eyes; blood facial story queued from Discord.

segments.title: Ramon Salazar Explains Vampire Facials / PRP
segments.notes: Salazar details micro-needling with platelet-rich plasma, mocks Kim Kardashian's viral selfie, claims decades of 'ethical' blood-sourcing via murder, references Diddy's Proactiv ads.

segments.title: Roof Session: Crum Theme Song 'I'm Scrummin'
segments.notes: Poll selects MVP entrance music instrumental; Crum records reluctant raw vocal over 'I'm Scrummin'' lyrics, hates music but refuses to let it win.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Case freestyles Rocket Man parody over trap beat, rhymes chatters' names with 'cat', raids out.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered top-of-hour station sign-on and countdown.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Commandeered cold open with freestyle rap about mortality, chains, and 'jizz' jazz before expiring.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued boat transformer superiority citing uncle boat parties; lost debate, four losses from Crum Dick Punch threshold.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued bridge transformer hard-counters boats; won 50/50 vote, leads debate score by four.

characters.name: Ramon Salazar
characters.notes: call-in guest. Explained vampire facials/PRP, claimed decades of blood-bathing via murder, mocked Kardashian selfie, referenced Diddy Proactiv ads.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical producer. Produced Crum's 'I'm Scrummin'' theme on roof using MVP entrance music instrumental.

storylines.beat: [45:11] Munch leads debate score by four; Crum four losses from pneumatic groin strike forfeit.
[49:14] Chat Beyblade activity signals Science Eyes debut tomorrow; tournament pledge remains pending.

lore_notes.fact: [49:14] New Chet Guy the Science Eyes studio construction nearly complete; debut expected next broadcast.
[1:06:19] Received first official theme song 'I'm Scrummin'' produced by DJ Newsic on MVP entrance music instrumental.
[56:51] Claims decades of 'ethical' vampire facials via murdering villagers and bathing in their blood; [1:03:32] claims past association with Dracula.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell covers the Homeland Security raids on Sean 'Diddy' Combs' properties amid sex trafficking allegations, then oversees a Munch & Crum debate where Munch extends his lead to four wins arguing bridge transformers hard-counter boat transformers. Ramon Salazar appears to explain vampire facials while claiming centuries of blood-bathing via murder, and the broadcast closes with DJ Newsic producing Crum's debut theme song 'I'm Scrummin'' on the roof before a raid-out.
